validation.internal: The compiler is an exact ideal-law construction for the stated radial qubit POVM and a state-independent classical postprocessing of the covariant spin POVM. Thus it cannot add state-inference information under the same measurement interface. The gamma variance gap is specific to the supplied kernel and specified estimators. The exact-all-t variance floor is a separate nonoptimal necessary condition. Numerical quadrature is not interval-certified.

relation_coverage: The N712 connection is a scoped statistical comparator only; its Gibbs/Fisher theorem does not transfer. No arbitrary-tuple or higher-dimensional compiler is claimed.
scientific_scope_status: For any normalized radial qubit POVM with M(x)=u(r)I+v(r)n·sigma and u>=|v|, the ideal compiler uses one random-axis projective spin measurement plus state-independent classical radius/sign randomization to generate the exact outcome law. Its outcome is a Markov postprocessing of the covariant spin POVM, so it cannot add state-inference information under that interface. For the supplied reciprocal-gamma kernel only, coordinate variance exceeds the stated random-Pauli shadow estimator by about 5.6399; this is not a universal estimator gap. A separate nonoptimal lower bound s²>=2+64/(27π⁴) applies only to radial mean-zero finite-variance noise in the exact all-t operator-identity class. Certified digital sampling, axis interface, novelty and physical capability remain UNKNOWN or unestablished.
